verification_commands: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendors WHERE vendor_code LIKE 'SEED-%';
SELECT v.name, COUNT(va.id) as addresses FROM vendors v LEFT JOIN vendor_addresses va ON v.id = va.vendor_id WHERE v.vendor_code LIKE 'SEED-%' GROUP BY v.name;
SELECT v.name, COUNT(vc.id) as contacts FROM vendors v LEFT JOIN vendor_contacts vc ON v.id = vc.vendor_id WHERE v.vendor_code LIKE 'SEED-%' GROUP BY v.name;
